scope: Release-era scope; later docs distinguished from release announcement

sources.finding: Release announcement names MegaLights experimental. Use that status for2024 narration, despite a later version-labelled documentation header saying Beta.

Stochastic direct-light samples and visibility tests; fixed ray budget is not fixed quality. Complexity and denoising can cause blur/ghosting. Hardware ray-tracing scene responsibilities overlap with Lumen, but direct light is not indirect illumination. Forward rendering is incompatible in the version-labelled page. Later/unversioned5.8 features are not copied into the2024 claim.
